name: Josiah Martin
public_footprint:
Josiah Martin is the owner-operator of Martin's Handmade Pretzels in Moira, NY (Franklin County, North Country), a fourth-generation family business making about 6 million handmade pretzels a year; he was named the 2026 SBA Small Business Manufacturer of the Year and was honored at the White House during National Small Business Week. He bought the business from his grandfather as a teenager and co-manages Martin's Country Store with his father.
Sources: https://www.nfib.com/news/news/member-spotlight-josiah-martin-of-new-york/; https://nysbdc.org/central-office/sbdc-clients-across-new-york-honored-with-state-and-national-small-business-awards/
